title: Editor E0 task 12b, leftover readers: the website seed, menu, nav, Contact and importer handle a stored node Space
detail:
Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. A stored native node document parses to rows with empty cells, so readers that ask which block types a Space places saw an empty page. lib/entity-blocks/node-projection.ts holds readTypeKeyedGrid (a native document is projected to its shown types with first-node bags; every other document parses as before) and nodeProjection (moved from spotlight.ts). Readers moved onto it: lib/sites/editor/seed.ts, manage/layout/menu-actions.ts, lib/spaces/profile-nav.ts, lib/spaces/contact-tab.ts, (profile)/contact/page.tsx, lib/sites/house-theme.ts. lib/importer/materialize.ts holds a stored node layout (published or draft) like a locked one, so a re-seed never overwrites node identities. Renderers (public, claim, full) already resolve nodes and are unchanged.

2026-10-20 (SCAN-832): the menu catalog reads moved from menu-actions.ts to lib/spaces/site-menu-core.ts so the website host can share them. Probe target updated to the new file; the check is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];if(!fs.existsSync('lib/entity-blocks/node-projection.ts'))bad.push('no type-keyed view');for(const f of ['lib/sites/editor/seed.ts','lib/spaces/profile-nav.ts','lib/spaces/contact-tab.ts','lib/sites/house-theme.ts','lib/spaces/site-menu-core.ts'])if(!fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').includes('readTypeKeyedGrid'))bad.push(f+' skips the type-keyed view');if(!fs.readFileSync('lib/importer/materialize.ts','utf8').includes('legacySpaceLayoutWriteError'))bad.push('importer can overwrite a node layout');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1056: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a leftover reader goes back to the raw parse (an empty page on a node Space) or the importer stops holding a node layout. Behavior is lib/entity-blocks/node-projection.test.ts and lib/importer/materialize.test.ts. The menu reads moved to lib/spaces/site-menu-core.ts (SCAN-832), shared with the website host twins; the probe follows the same check to that file.
